reset.cmd: psql "postgresql://app:app@localhost:5432/app" -c "DELETE FROM orders WHERE event_id = 1; UPDATE events SET remaining = 100 WHERE id = 1;"

invariants.name: 판매 수량이 재고를 넘지 않음
invariants.cmd: psql "postgresql://app:app@localhost:5432/app" -tAc "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE event_id = 1"

invariants.name: 남은 수량 + 판매 수량 = 재고
invariants.cmd: psql "postgresql://app:app@localhost:5432/app" -tAc "SELECT e.stock - e.remaining - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.event_id = e.id) FROM events e WHERE e.id = 1"
